usage: A common noun for a place that offers massage services; use it when talking about shops or businesses, not the action itself.
It usually appears after a verb like 去 or 開, for example when saying you go to a massage shop or open one.
In Hong Kong, it can sound neutral and everyday, but the exact service may vary, so context matters.
When giving directions or talking about local services, this word is very natural and easy to use.
